preconditions.description: The number of crimes n is a non-negative integer up to 10^18.
The number of conditions c is between 0 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and len(line.strip()) > 0 for line in stdin.strip().splitlines())
preconditions.description: The input consists of valid lines containing n, c, and c condition definitions.
Every multiplicity m_i in the conditions is a positive integer.
The product of all distinct multiplicities defined in the conditions does not exceed 123.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of valid sequences of length n modulo 12345, where a sequence is valid if for every crime type present in the sequence, its total count is a multiple of at least one of its defined multiplicities (or the crime type has no defined conditions and thus count must be 0).
The output is a non-negative integer strictly less than 12345.
